Interface DBResultSet

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface DBResultSet extends AutoCloseable
A simplified JDBC result set, read forward only, with one getter per type of Types, named and typed as in Value.

Column values are accessed by index, starting at 1 as in JDBC, or by alias, the label given to the column in the query (AS alias), which is the column name when no alias is given. Access by index is faster; access by alias is more readable.

Numbers and booleans are never null, so their getters return primitives. The getters of the nullable types (dates, times, strings and binaries) return null for a null value, so there is no need for a wasNull method.

Author:
Miquel Sas

    • next

      boolean next() throws SQLException
      Moves to the next row. The result set starts before the first row.
      Returns:
      A boolean indicating if there is a row, false after the last one.
      Throws:
      SQLException - If an error occurs.
